title: effigy.release.output.v1
description: What a release task target, artifact task or verify task writes at $EFFIGY_RELEASE_OUTPUT (contract 054 §6, §7). A task that exits 0 without writing one records committed = unknown.

committed.description: true: the candidate is at the destination. false: it is not. unknown: the task could not tell, and the Run reconciles before any retry.

destinations.description: Destination IDs: a release URL, a package@version, an image digest or a deploy ID.
